title: KB Creation Framework — Primary-Source Registry
description: Schema for sources/source-registry.yaml (v3.1.13+). Declares the primary sources a KB watches. Used by adapters/primary-source/ to pre-fetch sources at Phase 1.1 and diff-detect at Phase 6.3. Operator curates this file before Phase 0.0.

default_cache_path.description: Default cache directory relative to KB root. Defaults to 'external/primary-sources/cache' when absent.

auto_fetch_on_phase_1_1.description: If true, Phase 1.1 (Builder Research) pre-fetches all declared sources before dispatching builders. If false, sources must be fetched manually.

drift_report_on_phase_6_3.description: If true, Phase 6.3 (Extraction) re-fetches all sources and writes sources/source_drift_report.md flagging amendments.

sources.description: List of primary sources this KB watches.

id.description: Operator-assigned identifier, unique within this registry.

adapter.description: Which adapter to use for this source.

ref.description: Adapter-specific reference. Required keys vary by adapter.

cite_string.description: For ecfr: e.g. '17 CFR 240.10b-5'. For federal-register cite: e.g. '85 FR 12345'.

tags.description: Operator-assigned tags (e.g., topic ids, jurisdictions, register tiers).

criticality.description: foundational = KB cannot be correct without this source; supporting = adds depth; context = nice-to-have. drift in foundational sources should block the build.
